name: slow-shutter-korean-pure-sexy-selfie
image_vibe: Dreamy Pro-Mist flash, slow-shutter motion trails, warm lo-fi bedroom film
image_purpose: Create a four-panel atmospheric mirror-selfie collage with dynamic movement and analog imperfections.

prompt.project_info: A 2x2 mirror-selfie collage of an original adult woman using slow-shutter sync flash and camera panning.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with soft features, glowing diffused skin, long black hair creating silky motion trails, and a gentle dreamy smile. She wears an opaque white silk slip dress or opaque oversized white T-shirt, styled securely and naturally.
prompt.composition_elements: Four panels: laughing while turning her head; close-up wink; seated on the floor with a tilted camera and slight double exposure; covering her mouth with one hand. Set in a slightly messy cozy bedroom with warm bedside lamp, fairy lights, or neon reflection.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh but diffused flash in a dark room, Pro-Mist halation, warm glowing highlights, greenish shadows, intimate atmospheric lo-fi mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 2x2 grid, slow shutter sync flash, horizontal or rotational light trails, face relatively frozen by flash, soft focus, Kodak Portra 800 or Cinestill 800T color, heavy film grain and analog noise.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 2x2 mirror-selfie collage of an original adult woman in a cozy slightly messy bedroom, using slow-shutter sync flash and camera panning. Give her soft diffused features, glowing natural skin, long black hair forming silky motion trails, and a gentle dreamy smile. Dress her in an opaque white silk slip dress or opaque oversized white T-shirt, secured naturally. Panel 1 shows her laughing while turning her head, panel 2 a close-up wink, panel 3 seated on the floor with a tilted camera and slight double exposure, and panel 4 covering her mouth with one hand. Use harsh but diffused flash, Pro-Mist halation, warm highlights, greenish shadows, horizontal or rotational light trails, Kodak Portra 800 or Cinestill 800T color, heavy grain, and analog imperfection.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, translucent slip dress, exposed underwear, nudity, sexualized pose, unsafe motion, inconsistent face, distorted hands, plastic skin, watermark, text
